overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by inserting 'off school grounds' into the January 8, 2024 minutes, which the complainant never said; the rest of the minutes were adequate. Ordered compliance and an amendment within 30 days.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the January 8, 2024 minutes inaccurately said his child's incident occurred 'off school grounds', a location he never mentioned in public comment.
allegations.key_passage: the actual remarks made by the complainant during the January 8, 2024, meeting never indicated where the incident took place.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the January 8, 2024 minutes failed to include an accurate summary of his public comments overall.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the minutes are otherwise adequate and sufficiently summarize the discussions that occurred during the meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements
Within 30 days of the letter, amend the January 8, 2024 minutes to remove the reference that an incident occurred 'off school grounds'
remedy_passage: In addition, we order the Committee, within 30 days of the date of this letter, to amend the minutes of its January 8, 2024, meeting to remove the reference that an incident occurred “off school grounds.”
